name: Cherry Tomato
description: A small, sweet tomato variety that grows in clusters. Great for salads and snacking.
tips: Provide sturdy support as they can grow quite large. Water consistently to prevent cracking.
succession: Plant every 2-3 weeks for a continuous harvest.
yield: High yield, can produce hundreds of tomatoes per plant.

soil.type: Well-drained, loamy soil rich in organic matter.
soil.notes: Benefits from added calcium to prevent blossom-end rot.

temperature.notes: A warm-season crop. Fruit will not set at temperatures consistently below 55°F or above 90°F.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

storage.notes: Store on the counter, not in the refrigerator.

name: Beefsteak Tomato
description: A large, meaty tomato variety, perfect for slicing.
tips: Provide strong support due to the heavy fruit. Mulch to retain moisture.
succession: Not typically needed due to long harvest period.
yield: Lower yield than other varieties, but much larger fruit.

soil.type: Well-drained, fertile soil high in organic matter.

temperature.notes: A warm-season crop. Fruit will not set at temperatures consistently below 55°F or above 90°F.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

storage.notes: Store on the counter, not in the refrigerator.

name: Cucamelon
description: A small, grape-sized fruit that looks like a tiny watermelon and tastes like a cucumber with a hint of lime.
tips: Grow on a trellis to save space and make harvesting easier. The roots develop tubers, so a large pot is best if container gardening.
succession: Plant every 2-3 weeks for a continuous harvest.

temperature.notes: Loves warm weather. Very frost sensitive.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover with a blanket or bring potted plants indoors to protect from frost.

careTasks.description: Keep the soil consistently moist.

careTasks.name: Begin hardening off seedlings
careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week.

careTasks.description: Install a trellis at planting time.

careTasks.name: Fertilize
careTasks.description: Fertilize with a high-potassium liquid fertilizer to encourage fruiting.

careTasks.name: Harvest regularly
careTasks.description: Harvest when fruit is grape-sized.

name: Blueberry
description: A perennial shrub producing sweet, antioxidant-rich berries. Requires cross-pollination for best fruit set.
tips: Plant at least two different varieties for better pollination. Mulch heavily to maintain soil moisture and acidity.

soil.type: Acidic, well-drained soil rich in organic matter.
soil.notes: Requires acidic soil. Amend with sulfur if needed.

temperature.notes: Cold-hardy perennial. Most varieties require winter chill hours.

environmentalAlerts.message: Provide extra water and shade during extreme heat.

storage.notes: Store unwashed in refrigerator. Freeze for long-term storage.

careTasks.name: Water deeply
careTasks.description: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged.

careTasks.name: Apply mulch
careTasks.description: Apply 2-3 inches of acidic mulch around base.

careTasks.name: Fertilize with acid fertilizer
careTasks.description: Apply acidic fertilizer designed for blueberries.

careTasks.name: Harvest berries
careTasks.description: Pick berries when they are fully blue and easily detach.

name: Raspberry
description: A perennial cane fruit producing sweet-tart berries. Available in summer-bearing and everbearing varieties.
tips: Install trellis system for support. Prune old canes after harvest to promote new growth.

soil.type: Well-drained, fertile soil rich in organic matter.
soil.notes: Good drainage is essential to prevent root rot.

temperature.notes: Hardy perennial. Tolerates cold winters well.

environmentalAlerts.message: Late spring frosts can damage blossoms and reduce yield.

storage.notes: Very perishable. Use quickly or freeze immediately.

careTasks.name: Install trellis system
careTasks.description: Set up support system for canes.

careTasks.name: Water regularly
careTasks.description: Maintain consistent soil moisture.

careTasks.name: Apply compost
careTasks.description: Side-dress with compost for nutrition.

careTasks.name: Harvest berries
careTasks.description: Pick berries when they easily pull off the plant.

name: Blackberry
description: A thorny perennial cane producing large, sweet-tart berries. Very vigorous and productive.
tips: Wear gloves when harvesting due to thorns. Prune old canes annually for best production.

soil.type: Well-drained soil with good organic content.
soil.notes: Tolerates various soil types but prefers slightly acidic conditions.

temperature.notes: Hardy perennial but flowers can be damaged by late frosts.

environmentalAlerts.message: Cover plants if late frost threatens during flowering.

storage.notes: Store unwashed in refrigerator. Rinse just before eating.

careTasks.name: Install sturdy trellis
careTasks.description: Set up strong support system for vigorous growth.

careTasks.name: Deep watering
careTasks.description: Water deeply to encourage deep root development.

careTasks.name: Fertilize
careTasks.description: Apply balanced fertilizer during growing season.

careTasks.name: Harvest berries
careTasks.description: Pick when berries are fully black and soft.

name: Grape
description: A perennial vine producing clusters of sweet fruit. Takes several years to establish and produce significant harvest.
tips: Requires strong trellis system and annual pruning. Choose varieties suited to your climate zone.

soil.notes: Good drainage is critical. Avoid heavy clay or waterlogged soils.

temperature.notes: Cold hardiness varies by variety. Requires warm summers for fruit ripening.

environmentalAlerts.message: Late spring frosts can damage new growth and flowers.

storage.notes: Store in perforated bags in refrigerator.

careTasks.name: Install trellis system
careTasks.description: Build sturdy trellis to support mature vine.

careTasks.name: Weekly watering
careTasks.description: Water deeply once per week during growing season.

careTasks.name: Annual pruning
careTasks.description: Prune during dormancy to maintain shape and productivity.

careTasks.name: Harvest grapes
careTasks.description: Harvest when grapes are sweet and fully colored.

name: Apple
description: A fruit tree producing crisp, sweet apples. Requires cross-pollination from another apple variety for fruit production.
tips: Plant at least two different varieties for pollination. Annual pruning is essential for tree health and fruit quality.

soil.type: Well-drained, fertile soil with good organic content.
soil.notes: Avoid poorly drained or compacted soils.

temperature.notes: Requires winter chill hours for proper flowering. Very cold hardy.

environmentalAlerts.message: Late frosts during bloom can severely reduce fruit set.

storage.notes: Store in cool cellar or refrigerator for long-term storage.

careTasks.name: Deep watering
careTasks.description: Water deeply to encourage deep root development.

careTasks.name: Apply mulch ring
careTasks.description: Mulch around base but keep away from trunk.

careTasks.name: Annual pruning
careTasks.description: Prune during dormancy to maintain shape and health.

careTasks.name: Harvest apples
careTasks.description: Harvest when apples easily twist off the branch.
